description: Source code for generating and managing agent configurations and project setup in a Playwright-based environment, including classes for Claude, Opencode, Copilot, and VSCode generators, as well as utility functions for file operations and project initialization.

classes.name: ClaudeGenerator
classes.description: Handles generation of agent configs and setup for Claude-based agents.

classes.name: OpencodeGenerator
classes.description: Handles generation of agent configs and setup for Opencode-based agents.

classes.name: CopilotGenerator
classes.description: Handles generation of agent configs and setup for GitHub Copilot agents.

classes.name: VSCodeGenerator
classes.description: Handles generation of chatmode configs and MCP JSON for VSCode environment.

methods.name: loadAgentSpecs
methods.description: Loads agent specifications from markdown files in the current directory.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Utility to write content to a file with logging.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Utility to delete a file with logging.

methods.name: initRepo
methods.description: Initializes project directory, seed files, and prompts based on options.

methods.name: loadPrompt
methods.description: Loads and processes prompt template files with parameters.
